summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video: Creating a Decorative Quilted Headboard ## Introduction Welcome to MariusDesigner’s tutorial video. In this tutorial, we will learn how to create a flower-shaped air bed. ## Opening the Flat Bed File First, please open the flat bed file, which can be downloaded in the description. ## Drawing the Inner Circle To create the air bed line, you need to draw the inner circle on the board. 1. Please select the inner circle tool. 2. Click on the board and drag the mouse to create the circle. ## Duplicating the Inner Circle After drawing the inner circle, press `Ctrl-C` and then `Ctrl-V`. The moving mouse can see the blueprint. - At this time, press the mouse button to enter the number of duplicates. - After setting up the number, duplicate and paste it again to line up the inner circle. ### Adjusting the Number of Inner Circles When the number of inner circles is not enough, please duplicate and paste an inner circle until the desired amount is achieved. ## Positioning the Inner Circle Adjust the position of the inner circle and copy and paste it to fill the entire panel. ## Creating the Full-Face Panel To create a full-face panel, you will need to use the outer layer function to create another layer. To prevent the inner panel from deforming, freeze these panels and remove the face of the outer panel. ## Simulating the Surface Effect If you directly simulate it, the panel's surface effect may not be obvious. The point of moving the corner is to enlarge the outer panel. Ensure there is enough material to complete the surface effect. - Increase the pressure to 50 to achieve the surface effect. ### Viewing the Simulation To see the simulation, you can observe that the pattern and surface effect have already been created. In order to make the circular part look tighter, you can set the inner circle to 50. ## Creating Folds As the fold is created, the shape on the panel becomes clearer. - Reduce the pressure to 50 to achieve a more detailed fold effect. - The struggle will stay the same. Repeat the correct fold before even applying butter. ### Achieving a Smooth Folding Effect It is important to achieve a smooth folding effect. Let’s take a look at the creases on the fabric. The creases on the fabric will be very obvious, while the creases on the fabric will be less visible. ## Fabric Considerations The fabric is very soft and fluffy when used with a fabric that has a very small creasing force on the corner line. The creases also form a gap due to the compression of the creases. Therefore, after changing the fabric, you can adjust the pressure again to get a more suitable effect. ### Adjusting for Different Fabrics Not all silk is very soft; the shape of the creases may be very hard, and the surface effect may not be ideal. When the inner line has been sewn, keep changing the fabric to check the shape, as this may cause the shape to be distorted. ## Final Adjustments At this time, you can reset the arrangement of the version and re-model it to achieve a better creasing effect. ## Conclusion Thank you for watching! If you liked the video, please subscribe to the channel and press the bell to receive notifications when I upload a new video. See you in the next video. Bye bye! ```
